findings.summary: R8/S1 is not satisfied: the R1 discriminant cannot kill the mutation the spec names as mandatory. With AGENT_RESULT_TIMEOUT_MS=500 and AGENT_RESULT_POLL_MS=10, a reverted fixed 30-iteration readBody loop finishes 30x10ms=300ms inside the 500ms budget and still observes the 3rd-read result, so the test passes under S1. Spec section 3 requires 'R1 的生成段那条必须挂'. A killing discriminant is straightforward (e.g. make the generate result appear only after more than 30 polls, or assert readBody keeps polling past 30 reads), so this is a fixable gap in discriminant power, not an inherent limitation.

The dev-note S1 row asserts a structurally false justification: '两个路径在同一函数中实现（都调用 resolveAgentResultTimeout()），无法「只改一个」'. The two waits are independent literal loops in different assembly sites (generate readBody at src/tick-run.ts:1309-1320, triage readResult at src/tick-run.ts:1549-1560); either can be reverted alone, which is exactly what S1 asks for. Sharing a helper does not prevent isolated mutation. Spec section 4 point 2 forbids explaining away an unkilled mutation with a claim that is not true.

The R5 test is zero-power: it only asserts DEFAULT_AGENT_RESULT_POLL_MS === 3000 and DEFAULT_AGENT_RESULT_TIMEOUT_MS === 900000, which duplicates R2b and verifies nothing about tests avoiding real waits. Its name ('all G6 tests use AGENT_RESULT_POLL_MS <= 10ms') claims a property it never checks; the body concedes this in comments. Spec section 3 discipline states '零功率检查比没有更坏'. R5's substance is in fact carried by the other tests' env injection, so the assertion should either measure the injected poll interval or be removed rather than asserting defaults under an R5 label.

The dev-note records input_commit = d105c2a9fd8b6e13cc005e4e5e6e0c3e82b21a6a, which is neither the dispatch input_commit nor the implementation_subject_commit 761424f9fae0a733ed8ec9f7b6d4a5dbda7ed6e4. Spec section 4 point 3 requires recording the input_commit that dd handed to this attempt. Documentation-only discrepancy with no effect on product behavior.

Product implementation of R1-R4 and R6 is correct and complete as far as source inspection can establish: both waits use resolveAgentResultTimeout() with while(Date.now() < deadline) (src/tick-run.ts:1309-1320 and 1549-1560), defaults are 900000/3000 with env override (src/tick-run.ts:78-97), both timeout errors name the runId, triage keeps result !== null so [] stays distinct from not-found, and assertions drive runChannelWrite without triage injection plus assembleGenerateDeps (the same function production calls at src/tick-run.ts:1630). Section 5 non-goals are respected: readTriageResult semantics are unchanged and profiles/deploy/*.env contain no AGENT_RESULT_* values. The rejection is about mandatory R5/R8 evidence quality, not about the shipped waiting behavior.

R7 counts could not be independently confirmed: this review is read-only file inspection with no shell or Git execution, so the pasted tail (27 files / 486 tests / 6.74s) was not re-run. Static enumeration of test/**/*.test.ts does yield 27 files, consistent with the claimed file count and above the 26-file baseline.
